description: Main entry point and root widget for a Flutter app that initializes Supabase, displays a placeholder UI during startup, handles initialization errors, and shows a Todo list interface using the TodoService.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: StatelessWidget that manages application startup states, including loading, error display, and showing the main TodosPage.

classes.name: _InitErrorScreen
classes.description: Widget that displays detailed error message and instructions when Supabase initialization fails.

classes.name: TodosPage
classes.description: StatefulWidget that displays and manages a list of TODO items, including adding, toggling, and deleting todos, via TodoService.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Async entry point that initializes Flutter bindings, validates configuration, sets up Supabase, and runs the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Overridden method in widgets to compose UI based on current state (loading, error, or main list).

methods.name: _loadTodos
methods.description: Fetches list of todos from the backend service.

methods.name: _addTodo
methods.description: Adds a new todo item using TodoService and refreshes the list.
